explanation: From this branch: compare_author_results.mts now appends its R 4.4.1 review sentence to a regenerated output only when the spec was not pinned to the current regenerated bytes; every earlier spec pins a predecessor, so existing generated notes are unchanged. Dataset registration, bundle building and the dataset-change runbook are unaffected; the comparison builder runs only in the verification step. From main: The dataset-change route now tells builders to pass every track of a study to one writeDatasetBundles call (merged study files and derived QC counts, nSig at P<0.01) and to build sidecar intakes through buildIntakeStudies with staged publish, --check and --only. The September 5 builder is a hook on that pipeline; geo, batch2 and normalized builders no longer compute nSig, arm counts or is3v3. The HFD and OXT/AVP builders are unchanged because their intake audits fingerprint them.
